driver: issue #43 (description compression to the amended §3.5 listing-budget target)
method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING §6.5 fan-out, menu variant per houseCARL PR #295: one fresh-context judge per eval query (Opus, HIGH reasoning effort, no tools), each shown ONLY its single query plus the full lettered menu of all 11 NEW descriptions (anonymized, under-test skill unflagged) plus NONE, forced single pick, reasoning before verdict; one Opus adjudicator per skill scored recall/specificity from the judges' reasoning per §6.5 step 4. Judge model deliberately upgraded from PR #295's sonnet-low (maintainer decision). Contamination guard: the live install was moved aside for the fan-out window so fresh judges carried no stale skill listing. Gates: recall >= 80%, specificity >= 50%.
description_measured: Patch consumables for Requiem via houseCARL — potions, poisons, oils, food, drink, mead, skooma, and ingredients (ALCH + INGR), with effects, value, flags, and cookpot recipe derived from Requiem's comparables in Alchemy Redone / Food and Beverages Redone. The override IS the final balance — the Reqtificator never rebalances consumables — so load before any ALCH or INGR write.
adjudicator_notes: No reasoning-vs-token discrepancies. All 20 judges' reasoning matched their choice token — each explicitly weighed C against the named alternative and the stated conclusion agreed with the emitted entry, so no overrides were applied. Note the near-misses that resolved correctly: q14/q15/q18 all named C as the sole lexical candidate (potions, food, soup) and rejected it on mechanism/deliverable grounds (SkyPatcher INI, KID ini, OAR config), and q6 correctly held a plugin-wide "everything in KvSweets.esp" phrasing at C rather than escalating to G because the content was single-domain.
